question: Can current decision states distinguish worthwhile continuation from worthwhile early exit across previously authorized years?
design_type: No-fit fixed3x3 mechanism comparison; all nine full public accounts including one source-specific NOOP
selection_disclosure: 2025 examples and historical years already seen; candidate formulas selected for competing mechanisms and action responsibilities, not by querying their values on May30 or June19

hold_rules.ENTRY_GRACE: Only on the actual BUY-filled decision day suppress generic support early exit; next decision resumes original rule
hold_rules.TREND_CYCLE: Only if the actual BUY-filled day breaks original S5, current close>=prior MA20, prior MA20>its five-session lag and positive breach<=prior ATR20, suppress generic support early exits for that original cycle until original deadline

exit_rules.SHOCK_PROFIT: Held/discretionary state, D net floating return>0 and five-session log-return sum / (sqrt5 * sample std of the20 log returns endingD-5)>2
exit_rules.PROFIT_GIVEBACK: Held/discretionary state, observed peak_close*(1-.001)-actual_entry_fill*(1+.001)>=2*ATR20_prior and peak_close-currentclose>=ATR20_prior; current net return may be negative

priority: Existing pending sale inherited at start of D and mandatory original deadline first; then extra risk exit; generic support exit may be suppressed only by chosen hold rule

feature_clock_and_units.MA20_prior: Arithmetic mean of20 in-window closes endingD-1; compare with same value laggedfive sessions endingD-6
feature_clock_and_units.ATR20_prior: Arithmetic mean20 true ranges endingD-1; TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)) in original runtime market HFQ price units
feature_clock_and_units.volatility: Sample standard deviation ddof1 endingD-5, non-overlapping with numerator D-4..D; unavailable or zero scale explicitly not eligible, never infinite signal
feature_clock_and_units.peak_close: Maximum real observed Close from actual entry execution session through D; entryfill is only cost basis and never a Close candidate. EntryD giveback=0; reset on each real entry
feature_clock_and_units.net_floating_return: currentClose*(1-.001)/(actual_entry_fill*(1+.001))-1; known D mark, not a guaranteed next-session realized profit
feature_clock_and_units.unit_boundary: All MA/ATR/breach/peak/entry comparisons use runtime market price units; do not combine raw-execution or anchored ledger price/quantity scales

peak_definition_clarification: Before any new account/state outcome, root clarified close-only peak after an initial fill-initialization wording conflict; original method/protocol drafts retained and final revision binds this definition
economic_population: Original full funding/window and native execution constraints; strategy decisions generalize uniformly across dates, no hardcoded year or event-date exception
primary_evidence: Real continuous account paths, each year's own opening equity, original return/drawdown/frequency constraints, and counterexamples in2020-2024 as well as2025
feature_population: Original position/clock opportunity population and each policy's actual state triggers, each carrying D and E separately; no repeated-day-as-independent-event claim
2025_exclusion: Reaggregate2020-2024 historical development results without resetting history; not a pristine holdout or retraining experiment
2026_role: Full contract/source-control tail only; no rule selection or new economic validation from2026
same_economic_paths: Still run the simple fixed protocol; disclose equality and do not treat them as independent evidence
technical_failures: Stop dependent dispatch, preserve failure, review an explicit correction before a new immutable revision; no blind retry
economic_results: Run all technically valid predeclared arms regardless of whether early arms make money. No new economic hard gate or target relaxation
